sources.oracleProvider: Paragon oracle updater; institutional rate data providers

about.description: Perpetual market on the on-the-run 10-year US Treasury yield, deployed by Paragon via Hyperliquid HIP-3 and cash-settled in USDC. The index is the rate itself expressed in percent, not a bond price, so a one-basis-point move is 0.01 index points at any level and the payoff is linear in the rate with no convexity. Yields are sourced from institutional data providers while a source is publishing; off-hours the oracle advances internally and the mark is held within the market's bounds. Holding a contract confers no bond ownership or coupon entitlement.
